verdict_meaning.DIVERGENT: at least one case differed; see execution_blockers for the governing defect
verdict_meaning.NOT-APPLICABLE: an artifact was missing in one backend
verdict_meaning.PASS: every case of this fixture emitted byte-identical canonical JSON in both backends

execution_blockers.D-E2-01: RESOLVED 2026-08-11. E2-JSON-002 was enforced only in the Rust strict parser's i64/u64 visitors, so serde_json routed every integer literal wider than u64 to the binary64 visitor and accepted it with no status and no warning; where the literal was not exactly representable the stored value differed from the input (digit-form 1e30 became 1000000000000000019884624838656). The hole spanned |v| in [2^64, ~1.8e308]. The domain is now decided on the source text in checkpoint::portable_integer_violation, applied by both parse_strict_json and the public parse_public. Python never had the hole.
execution_blockers.D-E2-02: RESOLVED by normative E3-EVENT-001 options 1+4 (D-127): one discovery provenance per reciprocal pair; reciprocal saddle equality is mapping-aware; compatibility policy remains readable.
execution_blockers.D-E2-03: RESOLVED by D-114: serde_json float_roundtrip enabled; all emitted canonical artifacts re-read byte-identically.
execution_blockers.D-E2-04: RESOLVED by normative E3-CAN-001 (D-127): binary64 reals with magnitude >=2^53 use shortest exponent form.
execution_blockers.D-E2-05: RESOLVED by normative E3-STATUS-001(a) (D-127): context.component uses the pinned subsystem vocabulary.
execution_blockers.D-E2-06: RESOLVED by normative E3-STATUS-002(a) (D-127): context.details is corpus-pinned.
execution_blockers.D-E2-07: RESOLVED: Rust severity strings match the normative status table.

execution_status_meaning.BLOCKED: no conforming input can be constructed, so the fixture cannot execute at all
execution_status_meaning.FAIL_DEFECT: the fixture executes and the implementation does not meet the cited requirement
execution_status_meaning.PARTIAL: the fixture executes at the public-constructor level only; the catalog/trajectory half is blocked
execution_status_meaning.PASS: an executing language-local or cross-language test asserts the fixture contract and passes; scientific validation is separate
